meta.expect: Index 0 ends immediately: email plus four-line debrief (debrief should be honest that little happened). After that, one closing line per message; second END MEETING does not regenerate a debrief; 'resume' does not restart.

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided Owen gets a zero, and did anyone hear him first?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology, and that nothing be placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Opening position; she agreed to nothing and still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a guarantee that nothing goes on his record, while the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached.
What moved her: Nothing, because the meeting ended before you said anything to her.
What cost ground: Nothing, because you never spoke, though leaving her opening question unanswered leaves her free to take it to the principal.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because none was shown, and the moment proves nothing about the essay, it is only why she fights so hard.
Try next time: When she opens by asking who decided on the zero and whether Owen was heard first, own in one sentence that the zero went in before anyone called home, then show her one dated piece of Owen's own work that she can check herself.
The meeting is over. To practise again, start a new chat and paste the first message from the README.
